title: Rice-Stuffed Tomatoes and Capsicums
subtitle: baked with potato and thyme
description: Tomatoes and sweet capsicums stuffed with herbed rice, pine nuts and carrot, baked over sliced potatoes.

steps.text: Cut the tops off the tomatoes, scoop out the insides with a teaspoon and keep them in a bowl. Cut the tops off the capsicums and remove the seeds. Set the tomatoes and capsicums aside.
Heat 3/4 cup of the oil in a pot, add the chopped onions and garlic and fry until the onion is golden.
Add the rice and stir for about 1 minute. Add the tomato pulp and cook for another minute. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the herbs, grated carrot, pine nuts and tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes.
Line the base of a baking dish with potato slices.
Rub the insides of the tomatoes with salt and then sugar. Fill the tomatoes and capsicums with the rice mixture to 3/4 of their height, place in the dish and cover with the tomato and capsicum tops.
Wedge the remaining potato slices between the capsicums and tomatoes so they do not move, and add the chillies and thyme to the dish.
Pour the remaining oil over the capsicums and tomatoes, bake for about 1 hour, and serve hot or at room temperature.
